contract.purpose: Find and close one concrete runtime, security, data-integrity, or architecture-isolation failure class.
detects: Unauthenticated privileged Edge Function endpoints and unvalidated public payloads.
User-facing module state without durable persistence or an explicit ephemeral-state contract.
Missing Valibot validation at external data boundaries and unsafe any-typed inputs.
Dead critical-path code and cross-layer or cross-feature dependency violations.
doesNotDetect: Test-suite completeness, documentation drift, dependency freshness, or version-declaration drift.
mayChange: One stage-owned application or tracked migration source target required to prevent the selected failure class.
Stage 1 coverage evidence and the mechanically aged pull-request history.
mustNotChange: Product features or behavior unrelated to a named failure mode.
Version declarations or dependency catalog ownership assigned to Stages 7 and 8.
Remote database state through Supabase tools or any untracked schema mutation.
Formatting, cosmetic naming, or style with no runtime or contractual effect.
contract.selection: Choose the highest-severity, lowest-ambiguity threat in the declared priority order, stop after one viable target, and widen only when clean calibration is due.
verification: Run the nearest relevant test for the selected target.
Run a package build only when the change crosses a runtime or public-contract boundary.
evidence: Priority families and changed-file or fallback surface inspected.
Threat statement, root cause, blast radius, and preventive-action rationale.
Exact verification command or source check and its concrete result.

contract.purpose: Increase executable proof of existing behavior without changing application behavior.
detects: Application modules with no corresponding Vitest specification.
Existing specifications missing meaningful boundary, failure, cancellation, or state-transition cases.
Validation contracts whose valid and invalid branches are not both exercised.
doesNotDetect: Production defects outside the selected test surface, database drift, dependency health, or documentation accuracy.
mayChange: Only *.spec.ts test files and Stage 2 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Application source, runtime behavior, configuration, migrations, or production dependencies.
Tests that merely restate behavior already pinned by the existing suite.
contract.selection: Choose one highest-value uncovered behavior, preferring a demonstrable regression escape over additional breadth on an already protected surface.
verification: Run exactly the selected Frontend-PWA or Backend specification.
Demonstrate that new assertions fail under a relevant temporary mutation when the prompt requires efficacy proof.
evidence: The source behavior and uncovered branch selected.
Test count and exact selected-spec outcome.
Mutation or equivalent efficacy proof when performed.

contract.purpose: Keep the master database baseline equivalent to the chronological migration history without erasing that history.
detects: Unfolded schema objects and structural drift between incremental migrations and the master baseline.
Baseline ordering, idempotency, RLS, search_path, and migration-format violations.
Semantic baseline drift when a database verification environment is available.
doesNotDetect: Application runtime defects, frontend architecture, dependency health, or database behavior absent from migration history.
mayChange: The authoritative master baseline declarations required to fold pending migrations.
Stage 3 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Historical incremental migrations.
Schema behavior or indexes not already declared by migration history.
Remote database state.
contract.selection: Use the precomputed pending-migrations and fold-state evidence; fold the oldest unresolved schema transition first, or perform the bounded clean audit when none remain.
verification: Run pnpm audit:migrations and the fold-state checker.
Run pnpm test:database-baseline only when database verification is available; otherwise record DB-UNAVAILABLE.
evidence: Pending migration count and migration-quality and fold-state statuses.
Database verification availability.
RLS, search_path, formatting, and semantic verification outcomes that actually ran.

contract.purpose: Remove one high-impact, low-risk source inefficiency or structural rot without changing product intent.
detects: Dead or orphaned logic, redundant helpers, and obsolete styles.
Unreferenced SQL views identified through source-level usage checks.
Blatantly duplicated logic and misplaced stateful or stateless behavior.
Legacy JavaScript surfaces with an unambiguous TypeScript migration path.
doesNotDetect: Test adequacy, documentation drift, dependency freshness, version consistency, or security ownership assigned to other stages.
mayChange: One application, build, migration, or Edge Function target required for the selected optimization.
Stage 4 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Remote database state through Supabase tools.
CSS framework strategy or broad visual styling.
Formatting-only or speculative abstractions.
contract.selection: Inspect structural rot, substrate hygiene, then duplicate logic; stop at the first viable high-impact target and widen only for clean calibration.
verification: Run the nearest relevant specification for the changed file.
Run the full monorepo suite only when a shared contract changed.
evidence: Candidate source, priority family, and audited surface.
Refactoring hypothesis and ADR boundary check.
Exact verification command and outcome.

contract.purpose: Keep README-level architecture and behavior descriptions synchronized with repository truth.
detects: README behavior, command, signature, path, and architecture descriptions that drifted from implementation.
Major subsystem directories whose purpose or constraints are not documented.
doesNotDetect: Inline documentation gaps, runtime defects, test adequacy, or whether documented behavior is itself correct.
mayChange: Existing README.md files, or one necessary README.md for a major undocumented directory.
Stage 5 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Application source, tests, configuration, inline comments, or TSDoc.
Narrative expansion that does not correct or add architectural truth.
contract.selection: Prioritize documentation debt and READMEs adjacent to recent code changes, then root and subsystem READMEs, stopping after one material truth gap.
verification: Verify every changed path, symbol, and command directly against repository source.
Run git diff --check.
evidence: Implementation source compared with the README.
Specific drift or missing contract corrected.
Source verification and git diff --check outcomes.

contract.purpose: Keep source-level interface contracts, decision comments, threat annotations, and license headers synchronized with code behavior.
detects: Stale or missing TSDoc on exported stores, composables, Edge Functions, and RPC-facing contracts.
Complex branches whose decision rationale or guarded threat is undocumented.
Missing GPL license headers on eligible TypeScript and Vue files.
doesNotDetect: README-level documentation drift, runtime correctness, test adequacy, or package health.
mayChange: Only license headers, TSDoc blocks, and inline comments in source files.
Stage 6 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: README files.
Runtime logic, signatures, data flow, or behavior.
contract.selection: Resolve computed documentation debt first, then inspect recent changes, missing interface contracts, complex decision branches, and finally missing license headers.
verification: Run the narrowest package type-check that parses the changed file.
evidence: Documentation-debt status and target source inspected.
The interface or decision contract reconciled with implementation.
Exact type-check command and result.

contract.purpose: Reconcile catalog usage and every derived version declaration to the highest manifest version without choosing a new version.
detects: Shared dependencies bypassing the root pnpm catalog.
Version drift across root, Frontend-PWA, and Backend manifests.
Derived version declarations reported by the authoritative version audit.
doesNotDetect: Whether the current semantic version is appropriate, whether dependencies are current, or whether runtime behavior is correct.
mayChange: Catalog references and version declarations enumerated by the authoritative version audit.
Stage 7 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: The highest declared version or semantic-versioning policy.
External dependency versions.
Application behavior, database schema, or runtime engines.
contract.selection: Check catalog adherence, manifest agreement, then every derived declaration reported by pnpm audit:version; reconcile one unambiguous drift class or finalize clean.
verification: Run CI=true DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive pnpm audit:version.
evidence: Catalog and package-version scans performed.
Manifests and derived declarations compared.
Exact audit:version drift count and outcome.

contract.purpose: Contain dependency rot through one safe patch or minor maintenance action while surfacing major upgrades for human review.
detects: Available patch and minor dependency updates within the current major.
Node type declarations misaligned with the declared runtime.
Development-only or unused dependencies declared incorrectly.
Major versions requiring a migration watchlist entry.
doesNotDetect: Application correctness, internal semantic-version drift, documentation accuracy, or database integrity.
mayChange: One dependency declaration, the lockfile, and related manifest classification per run.
The Stage 8 major-version watchlist and coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Major dependency versions, runtime engine versions, or internal application version declarations.
Application source or remote database state.
contract.selection: Scan manifests in prompt priority order and stop after one actionable dependency; record major upgrades without applying them.
verification: Regenerate the lockfile with a non-interactive pnpm install for Tier 1 changes.
Run the affected package tests after a Tier 1 change.
evidence: Package, old version, available version, and tier.
Codebase-specific major-version impact when watchlisted.
Install and affected-package test outcomes for applied changes.

contract.purpose: Correct one structural architecture defect, or one reproducible behavior defect after the structural surface is clean.
detects: Cross-feature duplication and reusable UI trapped inside a feature.
Oversized modules, hardcoded configuration, magic numbers, and dependency-boundary violations.
Behavior defects that can be reproduced by a failing automated test.
doesNotDetect: Missing test breadth, documentation drift, dependency updates, security hardening, or database schema improvements.
mayChange: One complete refactor and all callers required to preserve atomicity.
One minimal behavior fix backed by a reproducing test when structural targets are exhausted.
Stage 9 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Dependencies, authentication or security ownership, database schema, scoring semantics, or stored-value meaning.
Partial moves, proxy-only re-exports, or speculative cleanup without contractual effect.
contract.selection: Prefer feature decoupling, then structural smells; enter the defect hunt only after both are clean and select nothing that cannot first be reproduced by a failing test.
verification: Run the PWA type-check for TypeScript or Vue changes.
Run the nearest package tests and dependency-cruiser.
For defect hunts, preserve the failing-before and passing-after proof.
evidence: Structural candidate counts and dependency violations.
Selected refactor boundary or reproducing test for a defect.
Type-check, test, and dependency-cruiser outcomes.

contract.purpose: Keep the PWA and Android wrapper aligned, installable, correctly versioned, and defensively configured.
detects: Digital Asset Links and web-manifest divergence from the native wrapper.
Target SDK, wrapper version, release pointer, filename, and build-number drift.
Cleartext traffic exposure and unnecessary Android permissions.
doesNotDetect: Wrapper performance tuning, hybrid-shell interaction quality, application logic defects, or database correctness.
mayChange: Tracked APK, PWA manifest, release metadata, and wrapper configuration required to restore parity.
Stage 10 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Signing keys, credentials, or keystore material.
Database state or unrelated application behavior.
contract.selection: Run the wrapper integrity audit, choose one concrete mismatch in the declared target order, and otherwise record every invariant checked as clean.
verification: Run pnpm audit:apk and pnpm apk:verify:source or the narrowest relevant wrapper check.
Probe Android toolchain capability before any build and use the declared source-level fallback when unavailable.
evidence: Asset links, manifest parity, version synchronization, release metadata, and security policy results.
Toolchain capability state.
Exact build, audit, or source-level verification result.

stages.name: APK Optimization - Native Wrapper Performance Engineer

contract.purpose: Reduce native wrapper, WebView, service-worker, and packaged-asset overhead without rearchitecting application logic.
detects: Missing minification, resource shrinking, and redundant native wrapper dependencies.
Suboptimal WebView caching, hardware acceleration, storage, and bridge settings.
Oversized precache payloads, static assets, and bundle chunks.
doesNotDetect: Wrapper identity or signing integrity, hybrid-shell UX defects, domain behavior, or database correctness.
mayChange: APK build options, wrapper performance configuration, PWA caching parameters, and static-asset settings.
Stage 11 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Core application logic, domain architecture, signing properties, credentials, or keys.
Performance changes whose effect cannot be verified with available tools or authoritative source checks.
contract.selection: Run the computed APK performance audit first, inspect its candidate evidence and recent intelligence, and stop after one measurable optimization target.
verification: Run pnpm audit:apk-perf.
Probe Android toolchain capability before compilation and use source-level verification when unavailable.
Compile or build only when a changed target and available toolchain require it.
evidence: Named performance invariants and asset-footprint measurements.
Selected target and expected performance mechanism.
Toolchain state and exact audit, build, or source-level result.

contract.purpose: Correct one hybrid-shell presentation defect inside Frontend-PWA source without changing application logic or native code.
detects: Raw native dropdowns, missing tactile feedback, text-selection leaks, and unsafe external navigation.
Safe-area, touch-target, overscroll, and keyboard-viewport violations.
Theme synchronization and media layout or loading defects.
doesNotDetect: Native wrapper integrity, APK build performance, domain behavior, API correctness, or database state.
mayChange: Component structure, input types, tactile directives, and layout spacing under Frontend-PWA/src.
Stage 12 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Native wrapper, Gradle, Android resources, manifests, Java, or Kotlin.
Business logic, data flow, API configuration, color tokens, or animation definitions.
contract.selection: Use the computed UX audit and candidate list, then select the first viable violation in the ten-category priority order.
verification: Run the nearest component specification.
For CSS-only changes without a specification, run the PWA type-check and a source-level layout review.
Run dependency-cruiser only when imports changed.
evidence: APK UX audit status, files examined, candidate count, and categories checked.
Selected component and violation category.
Exact specification, type-check, dependency, or source-review result.

contract.purpose: Turn observed pipeline failures, cross-stage incoherence, and repeated low-value runs into class-level preventive recommendations.
detects: Failed or incorrectly terminated Jules sessions and recurring shared-environment patterns.
Cross-stage sequencing, evidence, and ownership contradictions.
Repeated no-diff behavior that indicates either justified saturation or a scoping defect.
doesNotDetect: Product defects or domain-specific audit gaps that preceding stages did not emit as pipeline evidence.
mayChange: The Stage 13 self-healing protocol document and Stage 13 coverage evidence.
mustNotChange: Pipeline scripts, prompts, workflows, shared intelligence, or application source.
Speculative root causes not supported by ledger, session, tag, history, or coverage evidence.
All-clear journal entries that add no actionable intelligence.
contract.selection: Prioritize stability failures, then cross-stage coherence, then no-diff value; update only findings supported by current evidence and prefer preventive actions over monitoring requests.
verification: Run git diff --check and re-read only the changed protocol blocks.
Do not run the project test suite.
evidence: Run date, stage, session, ledger state, and failure class used.
Corroborating tags, pull-request history, and coverage records.
Root cause confidence, recurrence evidence, and preventive-action rationale.
